doha_start.hindi: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि । बरनउँ रघुवर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
doha_start.english: Having purified the mirror of my mind with the dust of my Guru's lotus feet, I describe the spotless glory of Lord Rama, which bestows the four fruits of life.

doha_start.hindi: बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवन-कुमार । बल बुधि विद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस विकार ॥
doha_start.english: Knowing myself to be lacking in wisdom, I remember you, O Son of the Wind. Grant me strength, intelligence, and knowledge, and remove my afflictions and impurities.

chaupais.hindi: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर । जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥
chaupais.english: Hail Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue; hail the lord of monkeys, who illuminates the three worlds.

chaupais.hindi: राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा । अंजनी-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥
chaupais.english: You are the messenger of Rama, the abode of incomparable strength, known as the son of Anjani and the Wind God.

chaupais.hindi: महावीर विक्रम बजरंगी । कुमति निवार सुमति के सङ्गी ॥
chaupais.english: Great hero, mighty as the thunderbolt, remover of evil thoughts and companion of wisdom.

chaupais.hindi: कंचन वरन विराज सुवेसा । कानन कुण्डल कुंचित केसा ॥
chaupais.english: Golden in complexion, beautifully adorned, with earrings and curly hair.

chaupais.hindi: हाथ वज्र औ ध्वजा विराजे । काँधे मूँज जनेउ साजै ॥
chaupais.english: Holding a thunderbolt and a flag, with a sacred thread adorning your shoulder.

chaupais.hindi: शंकर सुवन केसरीनन्दन । तेज प्रताप महा जग बंधन ॥
chaupais.english: You are an incarnation of Shiva and the son of Kesari, possessing immense brilliance and glory.

chaupais.hindi: विद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर । राम काज करिबे को आतुर ॥
chaupais.english: Wise, virtuous, and highly intelligent, always eager to carry out Lord Rama's work.

chaupais.hindi: प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया । राम लखन सीता मन बसिया ॥
chaupais.english: You delight in listening to the Lord's stories, and Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita dwell in your heart.

chaupais.hindi: सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा । विकत रूप धरि लंक जरावा ॥
chaupais.english: You took a tiny form to appear before Sita and a gigantic form to burn Lanka.

chaupais.hindi: भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे । रामचन्द्र के काज सँवारे ॥
chaupais.english: Assuming a terrifying form, you destroyed demons and fulfilled Lord Rama's mission.

chaupais.hindi: लाय संजीवन लखन जियाये । श्रीरघुवीर हरषि उर लाये ॥
chaupais.english: You brought the Sanjeevani herb and revived Lakshmana, bringing great joy to Lord Rama.

chaupais.hindi: रघुपति कीन्ही बहुत बड़ाई । तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥
chaupais.english: Lord Rama greatly praised you and said, 'You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata.'

chaupais.hindi: सहस बदन तुह्मारो जस गावैं । अस कहि श्रीपति कण्ठ लगावैं ॥
chaupais.english: Thousands of mouths sing your glory, said Lord Vishnu as He embraced you.

chaupais.hindi: सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा । नारद सारद सहित अहीसा ॥
chaupais.english: Sanaka and other sages, Brahma, Narada, Saraswati, and Shesha sing your praises.

chaupais.hindi: यम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते । कवि कोविद कहि सके कहाँ ते ॥
chaupais.english: Even Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions cannot fully describe your greatness.

chaupais.hindi: तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा । राम मिलाय राज पद दीह्ना ॥
chaupais.english: You helped Sugriva meet Rama and regain his kingdom.

chaupais.hindi: तुम्हारो मन्त्र विभीषण माना । लंकेश्वर भए सब जग जाना ॥
chaupais.english: Vibhishana followed your advice and became the king of Lanka.

chaupais.hindi: जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानु । लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू ॥
chaupais.english: You leapt toward the sun, thousands of miles away, mistaking it for a sweet fruit.

chaupais.hindi: प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं । जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं ॥
chaupais.english: Holding Lord Rama's ring in your mouth, you crossed the ocean effortlessly.

chaupais.hindi: दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते । सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हारे तेते ॥
chaupais.english: All difficult tasks in the world become easy through your grace.

chaupais.hindi: राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे । होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे ॥
chaupais.english: You guard the door of Rama; none may enter without your permission.

chaupais.hindi: सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना । तुम रक्षक काहू को डर ना ॥
chaupais.english: Those who seek refuge in you find all happiness and have nothing to fear.

chaupais.hindi: आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै । तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै ॥
chaupais.english: You alone can control your immense power; your roar makes the three worlds tremble.

chaupais.hindi: भूत पिशाच निकट नहिं आवै । महावीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥
chaupais.english: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near where your name is recited.

chaupais.hindi: नासै रोग हरै सब पीड़ा । जपत निरन्तर हनुमत बीरा ॥
chaupais.english: Diseases and suffering vanish by constantly chanting the name of brave Hanuman.

chaupais.hindi: संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै । मन क्रम वचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥
chaupais.english: Hanuman frees devotees from troubles when they meditate on him in thought, word, and deed.

chaupais.hindi: सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा । तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥
chaupais.english: Lord Rama is the supreme ascetic king, and you successfully complete all His tasks.

chaupais.hindi: और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै । सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै ॥
chaupais.english: Whoever comes to you with wishes obtains abundant rewards in life.

chaupais.hindi: चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा । है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा ॥
chaupais.english: Your glory shines throughout all four ages and illuminates the world.

chaupais.hindi: साधु सन्त के तुम रखवारे । असुर निकन्दन राम दुलारे ॥
chaupais.english: You are the protector of saints, destroyer of demons, and beloved of Lord Rama.

chaupais.hindi: अष्टसिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता । अस वर दीन जानकी माता ॥
chaupais.english: Mother Sita granted you the boon of bestowing the eight spiritual powers and nine treasures.

chaupais.hindi: राम रसायन तुम्हारे पासा । सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा ॥
chaupais.english: You possess the nectar of devotion to Rama and remain forever His devoted servant.

chaupais.hindi: तुम्हारे भजन राम को पावै । जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै ॥
chaupais.english: Through devotion to you, one attains Lord Rama and forgets the sorrows of many lifetimes.

chaupais.hindi: अन्त काल रघुवर पुर जाई । जहाँ जन्म हरिभक्त कहाई ॥
chaupais.english: At life's end, one reaches Lord Rama's abode and is reborn as a devotee of God.

chaupais.hindi: और देवता चित्त न धरई । हनुमत सेइ सर्व सुख करई ॥
chaupais.english: No need to focus on other deities; devotion to Hanuman brings all happiness.

chaupais.hindi: संकट कटै मिटै सब पीड़ा । जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥
chaupais.english: All troubles and suffering disappear for those who remember mighty Hanuman.

chaupais.hindi: जय जय जय हनुमान गोसाईं । कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं ॥
chaupais.english: Victory to you, Lord Hanuman! Please bestow your grace as a revered Guru.

chaupais.hindi: जो शत बार पाठ कर कोई । छूटहि बन्दि महा सुख होई ॥
chaupais.english: Whoever recites this Chalisa one hundred times is freed from bondage and attains great happiness.

chaupais.hindi: जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चालीसा । होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा ॥
chaupais.english: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa attains success, as witnessed by Lord Shiva.

chaupais.hindi: तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा । कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा ॥
chaupais.english: Tulsidas, the eternal servant of Hari, prays that you reside forever in his heart.

doha_end.hindi: पवनतनय संकट हरन मंगल मूरति रूप ।
doha_end.english: O Son of the Wind, remover of troubles and embodiment of auspiciousness.

doha_end.hindi: राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप ॥
doha_end.english: Reside in my heart along with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.
